dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Perla Mae arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Perla has been observed to be fearful. Noted to bite handlers when they picked her up out of kennel. These bites did not break skin. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an adult only home.
dog.name: Perla Mae
